description: This file contains the implementation of a Pagination class in PHP, which extends a system Controller class. It provides a method to generate pagination links for the OpenCart e-commerce platform, including logic for calculating pagination links, previous/next links, and outputting the pagination HTML view.

classes.name: Pagination
classes.description: A controller class responsible for generating pagination links in the OpenCart platform.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Generates a pagination view based on the provided settings such as total items, current page, limit per page, and URL template. It creates links for pages, previous, next, first, and last pages and returns the HTML view for pagination.
